prompt: Create a NEW original visual proposal for the Magic Mail cartoon puzzle game's postal cabinet obstacle. This is a redesign from scratch, not a recolor of an arched purple wardrobe. One landscape image, two equal-size states of the SAME cabinet side by side: LEFT closed with two doors; RIGHT doors removed, revealing exactly two wide horizontal compartments, with three neat stacks of ivory envelopes bearing small red wax seals per shelf. Design a charming compact nearly square postal sorting cabinet for a 2x2 game-board footprint. Flat top with a thick softly rounded wooden top slab, gently rounded outer corners, stout simple side rails, no legs or feet, no arched crest, no top emblem or envelope badge, no writing. Material palette: warm light honey/oak wood main faces and thick frame, slightly deeper caramel end grain, muted dark petrol-teal inset door panels on the closed state only, small solid aged-bronze rounded pull tabs positioned at the central seam. The open state has warm wood interior and darker walnut back panels; the thick middle shelf reads clearly. Make a cohesive inviting piece of original magical-post-office furniture, clean strong silhouette readable at tiny mobile puzzle size, thoughtful joinery, broad softly chamfered edges, light stylized woodgrain only. Rich polished hand-painted cartoon 2.5D craftsmanship, upper-left illumination, restrained glossy edge highlights, tangible rounded volume, colorful yet not gaudy. More like a sturdy friendly purpose-built postal cabinet than an ornate bedroom wardrobe. Do NOT use bright gold outlining, royal filigree, carved arches, oversized decorative trim, purple, gems, clocks, characters, locks, additional drawers or compartments. No floor, no scene, no typography, no labels. Fully front-facing orthographic view, both cabinets same proportions and exact design, fully contained, generous separation and margin. Transparent background. This is a material/design study, not final game sprites; the visible stacks are illustrative rather than a new gameplay inventory specification.
notes: Flat rounded top, honey oak wood, petrol teal door insets and bronze pulls.
Closed/open design study, not production sprites or gameplay stock specification.
No Unity, prefab, gameplay or campaign edits.
